questions.stem: To construct a perpendicular to a line from a point not on the line, the first step is to:

options.text: Draw a parallel line through the point
Draw arcs from the point that cross the line at two points
Measure the distance from the point to the line with a ruler

questions.explanation: Place the compass point at the given point and draw an arc that crosses the line at two points. Then construct the perpendicular bisector of the segment between those two crossing points.
